name: Bounded diagnostic delivery loss emits a GapEvent

input.source_text: class B {} module M { public fun run() -> Object { Revision.subscribe({ |event| :seen }, 1); B.open() { |t| 1 }; B.open() { |t| 2 }; Revision.flush() } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Bounded subscriber delivery and its gap record are observable from source.
